items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1960-03-15
items.q: Sam Charles told me about yellow.

ctx.x: You see? That's a bad thing to say. That's why we called him yellow. Because he was olive complexion, you see? That's a bad thing to say. That's why we called him yellow. Because he was olive complexion, you see? Sam Charles told me about yellow. He knew that. No, he wasn't one of those. Papa Lane and Mama Lane said that he was white. He was white. Yeah. They knew it. The parents and the whole family. Now, he's white. Was that about Steven Allen?
